doctrine: NEVER turn parser guess into fact: hostile inputs get typed lane-K failure records or bounded extraction with per-claim provenance; conflicts stay unresolved; uncorroborated identity signals stay unclaimed.
contract_ref: lane-d HOSTILE-INPUT-CONTRACT.md parse bounds P1-P8; lane-k FAILURE-TAXONOMY.md v1.0.0 (13 classes)

results.title: RSS with atom: namespaced element ignored
results.threat: Foreign-namespace children are not parsed; core entries claim.

results.title: xml:base present but relative href still quarantined
results.threat: The lab does not resolve xml:base (no base guessing); relative stays relative.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: guid with surrounding whitespace -> trimmed
results.threat: Identity whitespace is normalized before tracking.

results.title: two items, same link, different guids -> dedupe by link
results.threat: One URL observed twice is one discovery.

results.title: uppercase scheme HTTPS:// -> claimed
results.threat: Scheme match is case-insensitive per URI spec; no normalization applied.

results.title: link with explicit port -> claimed verbatim
results.threat: Ports are part of the URL; no authority normalization is guessed.

results.title: unicode domain claimed verbatim, no punycode guess
results.threat: No IDN conversion is attempted; the URL claims exactly as written.

results.title: two-digit-year pubDate accepted
results.threat: Date.parse semantics; the lab does not second-guess the parser.

results.title: atom entry missing title -> link still claims
results.threat: Titles are optional metadata, not identity.

results.title: atom self + alternate links -> alternate claims
results.threat: rel=self is the feed address; only rel=alternate is the entry link.

results.title: atom enclosure-only link -> missing-link quarantine
results.threat: Without an alternate, there is no entry link candidate.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: link that decodes to markup -> empty -> missing-link quarantine
results.threat: Entity decoding then tag stripping can erase the candidate; that is quarantine, not a claim.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: CDATA link claimed literally
results.threat: CDATA is literal text through the pipeline.

results.title: comment between channel and item ignored
results.threat: Comments are skipped at every level.

results.title: processing instruction inside feed skipped
results.threat: PIs are never entries or fields.

results.title: pubDate before link (field order) -> claims
results.threat: Field order inside an entry is irrelevant.

results.title: atom updated with +05:00 offset accepted
results.threat: RFC3339 offsets validate.

results.title: atom published-only date accepted
results.threat: published is a valid date signal; updated is not mandatory.

results.title: rss ttl/skipHours ignored
results.threat: Channel-level tuning elements are not entries.

results.title: item author email ignored
results.threat: Author metadata is not a discovery signal.

results.title: guid isPermaLink="TRUE" (uppercase) -> true
results.threat: The flag comparison is case-insensitive; guid==link yields one claim.

results.title: duplicate guid, different link -> unresolved
results.threat: Same identity pointing at two URLs: no canonical link is picked.

results.title: three alternates, two identical one different -> unresolved
results.threat: Majority does not resolve; differing alternates are a conflict.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: link with query params claimed verbatim
results.threat: Query strings are part of the URL as written.

results.title: trailing-dot domain claimed verbatim
results.threat: No FQDN normalization is guessed.

results.title: description iframe stripped
results.threat: Embedded frames never survive content extraction.

results.title: atom xhtml content flattened
results.threat: XHTML content blocks reduce to text.

results.title: deeply nested title markup stripped
results.threat: Nesting depth does not protect markup from stripping.

results.title: feed title entities decoded in notes
results.threat: Notes carry decoded text; they are not claims.

results.title: RSS 1.0 rdf:RDF root -> typed UNSUPPORTED
results.threat: Only RSS 2.0 and Atom are supported; other roots classify, never parse.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: rss without version attribute still parsed
results.threat: Root local name decides; the version attribute is not a gate.

results.title: plain http link claimed
results.threat: http is allowed; the scheme allowlist is http(s), not https-only.

results.title: internal newline in link collapses to space, claimed literally
results.threat: Whitespace normalization is literal; the lab does not repair URLs.

results.title: two channels -> items in both claim (documented)
results.threat: Channel boundaries are not enforced; entries anywhere under root are entries.

results.title: atom empty href -> missing-link quarantine
results.threat: An empty href attribute is no candidate.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: atom logo/icon ignored
results.threat: Feed-level media elements are not entries.

results.title: empty guid -> no identity tracking, link claims
results.threat: Empty guids are not identities.

results.title: empty pubDate -> no date quarantine
results.threat: An absent date is not a malformed date.

results.title: bare-domain link claimed
results.threat: No path is required.

results.title: userinfo without password -> credential-link quarantine
results.threat: Any userinfo in the authority is secret-shaped and quarantined.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: single-quoted atom href claimed
results.threat: Attribute quoting style does not matter.

results.title: entity in atom href decoded once
results.threat: Href entities decode exactly once.

results.title: title exactly at 4KiB cap -> no truncation flag
results.threat: At-cap is accepted; only over-cap truncates.

results.title: title at 4KiB+1 -> truncation flagged
results.threat: One byte over the cap fires the flag.

results.title: exactly 10000 items -> no truncation flag
results.threat: At-cap boundary: accepted without the flag.

results.title: xml:lang on entry ignored
results.threat: Language attributes are not parsed.

results.title: rss docs element ignored
results.threat: Spec-pointer elements are not entries.

results.title: duplicate atom href across entries -> dedupe
results.threat: Same URL in two entries is one discovery.

results.title: leading whitespace before prolog accepted
results.threat: Whitespace before the XML declaration is legal.

results.title: feed kitchen sink 2 -> exact claim set
results.threat: xml:base-relative, empty-href, bad-date, guid-conflict, and extension items at once.
